_comment: What the campaign's arms EXECUTE differently, declared BEFORE any paper cell (incident-graph-ladder-confound-20260916, rule 1). verify_execution_differences.py reads every arm's boot snapshot and refuses the campaign on any difference not listed here. Values are per arm; a field absent from an arm's entry must be equal across all arms.

tolerances._note: kv_capacity_tokens_abs = the EXACT expected displacement: the treatment's router/projector weights (480 MiB, 128 KiB per K/V token for Llama-3-8B fp16) cost 3,840 K/V tokens on every card -- 0.98 % of the A100's 393,319-token pool, 2.07 % of this 48 GB card's 185,766 (judgement 1 of rtxa6000_gsm8k, 2026-09-17 11:15Z). Owner 11:3xZ: the expected trade-off (a smaller pool traded for the projector weights); the gate passes a smaller_ok pool that is at most this many tokens smaller.

upstream.reason: literal SGLang default ladder on this 48 GB card

vskipper.reason: design: the fork captures 4x max_bs (vpipe/common.py); its router/projector weights shrink the K/V pool by <1.5 % (against the treatment)

upstream_g128.reason: same-ladder control on the RTX A6000: --cuda-graph-max-bs 128 = the fork's 4x memory-derived default (D-824 posture, this device)

fork_default.reason: any arm served from the fork tree (RandomSkip sweep mocks, ablation arms, Qwen arms): the same coverage ladder as vskipper and the same router/projector HBM cost

_comment_decode_kv_band: fork arms: 'rule' = the live regime-switch K/V band must equal roofline.derived_kv_band for the device the gate is told it runs on (per-device table SERVED_DECODE_KV_BAND_BY_DEVICE, every entry a rule output; A100 keyed by memory class); 'shared' = the arm attests decode_kv_band_policy shared (a declared deviation, D-778 Qwen posture). Absent for a fork arm = refused.
_comment_device: RTX A6000 (48 GB, sm_86): SGLang's memory-derived default decode ladder on this card is 32 rows and the fork captures 4x = 128 (not 1,024 as on 80 GB parts), so the same-ladder control here is upstream with --cuda-graph-max-bs 128 (arm upstream_g128). The execution-difference gate refused the 1,024-row control against the fork's 128-row ladder on 2026-09-17 06:46Z, as designed.
